text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
The guy the inspector keeps around—Hanzo? I wonder who he is.
I know it's a bit odd for me to say, but he looks all sorts of strange.
choice_data_list: I know a girl who wears clothes like his...
text_block_list.orig_text:
監査官が
連れてる
ハンゾウ？
　って
何者なのかしら。
私が言うのもなんだけど、
なんだか変わった格好してるわよね。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
Boys really like that sort of thing, huh? But if he likes to hide in dark
places, why does he dress like that during the day? It makes him stand
out... right?Intimidation? Does he do it to scare people?
text_block_list.orig_text:
男の子って
そういうの好きよね。
けど、
闇に生きる
っていうなら、
昼間にあの格好はどうなのかしら。
逆に目立つ……
わよね。
威嚇？
　威嚇なのかしら。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
You serious...? But if you think so, it probably is, right?
Huh? It was supposed to be a joke? Sorry!
I'm not sharp like Mahiru, so comebacks aren't my thing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれが……？
　
でも、
そう思っちゃうってことは
本当にそうなのかも。
え？
　あなたなりの冗談だったの？
　
ごめんなさい！
マヒルちゃんみたいに
上手に突っ込めなくて。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
There's really a girl who looks like that? You sure do have many types
of acquaintances. Do you know anyone who looks like me? Of course
you don't. But that's good! Because to you, I'm a one-of-a-kind girl!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんな格好をした子がいるの？
　
あなたって本当に顔が広いのね。
私みたいな子は他にいる？
　いない、
わよね。
けど
いいの！
あなたにとっての
オンリーワンだって思うことにするから！
